messages.subject: by which code i could calculate the genotype missing rate in my rils population
parts:
i have this rils population total 100 lines which contain more than 1200 markers, i have see many individuals have lots missing genotype, could be more than 100 out of 1200.

how could i calculate the missing rate and how should take the right minprob?

best
ma

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] by which code i could calculate the genotype missing rate in my rils population
parts:
Here's how to calculate the proportion of missing data:

x <- read.cross( .... )

# proportion of missing genotypes by individual
p_mis <- nmissing(x) / totmar(x)

# top ten
sort(p_mis, decreasing=TRUE)[1:10]

# histogram
hist(p_mis, breaks=20)

I can tell you what the right missing genotype rate is. I'd generally be looking for outliers (with much higher rates of missing data than others), and would omit a line only if I felt that the remaining data was bad.

karl
